title: high stakes lifts builder roles to high_stakes, so proof-checked builders run on the top model
detail: prusik/model_tier.py tier_class moves every bounded non-fixed role up one step at high stakes, including backend-builder, frontend-builder, solo-builder and test-writer. Observed 2026-11-19: observed-writes scored 6 (L+P1+team+hook+ledger) and resolved both builders to opus; $12 of the $31.68 attempt was Opus builder spend. A builder's output is checked by tests, gates and reviewers, so a weaker builder costs a fix round, not an escaped defect. Expected: builder roles keep their base class at any stakes level; critics and reviewers still lift; a plan's ## Model tiers override can still lift a builder with a stated reason.
